title: Indoor Room Temperature Sensor Fault
shortDescription: The indoor ambient temperature sensor has malfunctioned.
fullDescription: The E1 error code on TCL air conditioners indicates the indoor unit room temperature thermistor is reading outside its normal range. The sensor may be open-circuit, short-circuit, or disconnected.

fixSteps.title: Power cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Turn off at breaker for 5 minutes.

fixSteps.title: Inspect sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Remove front panel. Check sensor near air intake. Verify connector is firm.

fixSteps.title: Test thermistor
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect and test resistance (approx 10K ohms at 25C).

fixSteps.title: Replace sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Remove old sensor, install replacement in same position.

whenToCallPro: If sensor tests fine but E1 persists.

title: Indoor/Outdoor Communication Error
shortDescription: Communication between indoor and outdoor units has failed.
fullDescription: The E6 error code indicates the signal wire between units is broken, loose, or a PCB communication circuit has failed.

fixSteps.title: Check signal wire connections
fixSteps.instruction: Turn off power. Tighten terminal screws at both units.

fixSteps.title: Test wire continuity
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect at both ends. Test each conductor.

fixSteps.title: Inspect for damage
fixSteps.instruction: Trace wire route. Look for pinches, rodent damage, weather exposure.

fixSteps.title: Check for interference
fixSteps.instruction: Ensure signal wire is routed 12+ inches from power cables.

whenToCallPro: If wire and connections are fine but E6 persists.
